fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The campus access road off S. Mason Avenue is an open, unbarriered private drive — confirmed in 2018-10 and 2025-04 Street View. No barrier arm or gate at the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the campus entrance in any Street View heading.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — no gate exists, so remote check-in flag does not apply.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building Pactiv manufacturing campus — 4+ large buildings clustered around a private internal access road off S. Mason Avenue. Pactiv Evergreen blue branded sign confirmed at the office entrance (2025-04 Street View).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal campus road is long and deep; ample queue depth between the public road and the dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks on the SW face of the dark-roofed central building (~8-10 doors) plus additional doors on the brick building faces; total banded 10-25, estimate.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur curves into the NE edge of the campus from the adjacent Belt Railway / Clearing Yard; rail cars visible (z19 satellite).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 4+ large buildings on the campus; exact count uncertain — some may be separately occupied within the same industrial park.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible on the campus.
